proxy.mask: original basis_train fixed dense masks shared R/D/O
proxy.online: fixed full K=4 with original independent source clone

objectives.O: post-one-native-Adam source query region loss; host+0.1*proxy inner; original moments and counters
objectives.zero_second_moment_derivative: sqrt forward exact, derivative zero at exactly zero; native derivative elsewhere

source.history_role: basis_train excluding original K4; fallback critic_train only if empty
source.score_role: original 20/32 critic_validation; after all training only

episode_sequence: seeded shuffled state indices cyclic to600 (counts18/19), shuffled query indices cyclic, transforms clean/gamma0.7/gamma1.5/blur5sigma1 cyclic; same D/O sequence

target.exclude: explicit sealed assets, image-mask conflicts, full-source image overlap, known source-target association overlap, later-domain duplicate
target.empty_domain: record missing and evaluate other domains
target.label_access: only evaluator after prediction; raw-byte/container identity checks during registration

evaluation.metrics: existing final-grid Dice and ASSD; nearest masks; Fundus OD<255/OC0, Polyp>127
evaluation.task_aggregation: equal-domain mean; Fundus OD/OC macro; no cross-task average
evaluation.statistics: mean, median, unrounded sign counts, ascending worst ceil(0.1*n) Dice difference; ASSD common valid cohort, empty/full/undefined counts; pixel units

stop: identity, encoding, gradients, nonfinite, source mutation, OOM, budget; retain prefix; no formal rerun or automatic resume
interpretation: exploratory single seed/order, off-policy Base history truncated one-step; GM is prompt-space adaptation baseline; no SOTA/clinical/privacy claim; no score gate or automatic extensions
